name: HSP Polymers 6
description: Re-processed Hansen Solubility Parameters Table A.1 solvents from the original PDF source (Hansen 2007, 'a1 and a2 only.pdf'). Full enrichment pipeline: name cleaning, IUPAC/common name resolution, CAS lookup, SMILES, molecular formula, physical properties (MW/BP/density), ClassyFire chemical taxonomy, GHS hazard codes. Cross-referenced against hsp_solvents_2 for enrichment. Processing pipeline: pipeline_hsp_polymers_6.py.
quality_notes: Source: Hansen PDF Table A.1 (1130 solvents). Reference hits (hsp_solvents_2): 908/1130 (80%). IUPAC name coverage: 908/1130 (80%). CAS coverage: 903/1130 (80%). ClassyFire coverage: 702/1130 (62%). PubChem 503 errors for ~222 unmatched solvents during pipeline run — these rows have basic HSP data only.
